name: booking_sdk
_comment_requires: booking_sdk >= 1.1.0 recovers the table-reservation flow that was lost when the shells were extracted (customer: paas_customer's web-only Reservation hand-off; seller: paas_pos's TablesPage). It requires base_sdk >= 1.46.0 (ListFilterTabBar from the standard list language, ProfileSectionRegistry, PlatformGateway, AppHelpers.getReservationEnable) and a backend carrying commerce booking/frappe with `api.booking.get_booking_settings` and `api.booking.get_shop_booking_schedule` (this same commerce change); against an older backend the flag bridge fails open (the Reservation button stays hidden) and the schedule read fails through ApiResult.failure. The customer flow lists shops through base_sdk's ShopsRepositoryFacade, which merchants_sdk registers in customer composes; without it the flow reports that shops are unavailable. The composer manifest schema has no machine-readable minimum-version field, so this is the declaration.

di_hooks._comment: The visibility flag without a core change: wraps the registered SettingsRepositoryFacade (comms_sdk) so getGlobalSettings() carries `reservation_enable_for_user` from the booking-owned `api.booking.get_booking_settings` (Permission Settings enable_reservations). base_sdk's AppHelpers.getReservationEnable() and marketplace's profile gate then work unchanged. Order 30 so it runs after every *SdkDependencies.register (the installer emits di_hooks after the generated DI block) and after sibling hooks that might register the facade. Fail-open: a booking failure leaves the inner result untouched.

_comment_tr_keys: Declared here rather than hand-written into base_sdk because only this SDK uses them; injected into base's TrKeys between the @sdk-tr-keys markers for the installed templates. lib/ code references the same wire keys through BookingTrKeys (orders_sdk precedent: lib/ analyzes against raw base_sdk where the injected constants do not exist). `reservation` is base-owned and deliberately not redeclared. AppHelpers.getTranslation humanizes any key the translation store lacks.

routes._comment: The customer's reservations (paas_customer's profile Reservation button used to open {webUrl}/reservations in a web view; marketplace_sdk 1.13.0 pushes this path instead). Installed page carries @RoutePage(name: 'ReservationsRoute'); auto_route generates the class in the host's app_router.gr.dart.

Shop -> section -> table -> day/time -> confirm. Optional ?shopId=<Shop docname> query parameter pre-selects the shop. A flat path (not /reservations/new) so auto_route's exact matching never needs prefix matches.

customer._comment: Customer block: My reservations (list + cancel) and the reservation flow. The 1.0.x reservation_shops.dart template (a web hand-off that nothing navigated to) is gone; marketplace_sdk's profile Reservation button now pushes /reservations, gated by AppHelpers.getReservationEnable() exactly as before.

routes._comment: paas_pos's TablesPage booking list with New / Accepted / Cancelled status changes. Manager-prefixed route names (orders_sdk / revenue_sdk convention), CupertinoRoute like the sibling manager pages.

di_hooks._comment: Registers SellerBookingRepositoryFacade (demo-gated) and the RESERVATIONS group (ProfileSection id booking.reservations, order 135) on base_sdk's ProfileSectionRegistry, which is how the manager profile host reaches the three routes above without merchants_sdk changing. Order 14: after orders' manager DI (10), before its POS facades (20); it depends on neither.

manager._comment: Seller block, recovered from paas_pos@78ccee4520666ca15788cccf5b9638ee1e6140ab (lib/src/presentation/pages/tables/*, repository/table_repository*): reservation list with status updates, section + table CRUD, booking hours (Booking slots), working days and closed dates - only what booking/frappe serves. Dropped because the server has no counterpart: getStatistic (booking statistics), getTableInfo's `get_booking?id` lookup, and the disableDates stub. POS shells compose this SAME manager block: pos.json composes orders_sdk / merchants_sdk / kitchen_sdk, none of which declares a pos persona, so a pos shell resolves as the manager persona. A separate app_type.pos block was deliberately NOT declared - sdk_composer.strip_unused_role_folders removes lib/src/<persona>/ for every declared persona other than the app's own, so a declared pos persona would strip lib/src/manager/ from a pos compose and break its own imports.
